notes:
Summary: Veridian runs a multi-tenant B2B SaaS helpdesk platform (40k tickets/mo). Evaluating Redwood for ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging integration into Zendesk. Key ask: keep agent-facing latency <300ms for snippet suggestions; end-to-end processing for batch email triage <=30s; survive 3x traffic spikes during product launches without dropping suggestions.

Call notes (shorthand):
- 2026-02-10 kickoff w/ Head of CX (L. Moreno) + Eng lead (R. Patel). Wants: extract problem, root-cause suggestion, 3-line agent summary, auto-assign tags and macros.
- "If we can cut average handle time by 22% and keep NPS stable, it's a go" — L. Moreno.
- Interested in outbound macro recommendations (one-click apply macros in Zendesk via app).
- Data residency: EU customer subset must have data residency in eu-west region; will require Private or Dedicated with VPC peering.
- Security: SOC2 required; KMS integration for keys; audit logs retained 2 years for regulated customers.
- Price sensitivity: mid — willing to commit to Dedicated if ROI clear within 9 months.
- POC scope agreed: 2-week sandbox, Zendesk test org, sample of 10k tickets across 3 product lines, synthetic spike run at 3x baseline.

Artifacts: pricing deck link shared (drive), security questionnaire in flight, app submission to Zendesk marketplace pending.

Open questions: failure mode when backend busy (fallback to cached summaries? degrade to title-only?), how tokenizer/quantization affects extraction quality for short emails.

Next action items: SE to run perf test with 1 GPU vs 2 GPU Dedicated config; AE to push SAML metadata to IdP; product to validate webhook load under spike.

requirements_summary: Workload: real-time agent assist + nightly batch email triage. Targets: per-suggestion latency <300ms (p95) for single-ticket lookups; batch triage throughput 10k/hr; accurate tag suggestions (precision >0.85 for top-3). Must integrate into Zendesk via app and support one-click macro application. SSO/SAML + KMS + audit logs required. Prefer dedicated capacity for predictable spikes; fallback route to cheaper hosted models for non-sensitive EU traffic.
zendesk_integration: Needs Redwood app that can: 1) receive ticket payloads via webhook, 2) return 3-line summary + top-3 tags + suggested macro id, 3) support inline streaming suggestions for agent UI, 4) admin controls to enable/disable auto-tagging per group. Also requires Zendesk Marketplace app review and install guide.
sales_notes: AE/Jordan: focus negotiation on committed throughput tiers and quantized model options. Offer a 3-month ramp with price band for spike credits. Use Redwood Optimize to recommend batching and cache policies for Veridian's ticket patterns.
additional_context: Support org: 180 agents distributed NA/EU. Heavy macros library — ~250 macros. Zendesk native automations currently rule-based; they want ML-driven tag suggestions to reduce false positives and maintain routing SLAs. Engineering team prefers a predictable Dedicated plan with VPC peering for EU region.
